第一章 大姐，我想这是个误会（三）

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

宫廷女侍卫显然被他的外表迷惑了一下，眼中怒色略微缓和几分，冷声道：“放不放过你，并不是我说了算的。等待殿下处置吧。”

“殿下？天啊！你说的该不会是帝芙雅公主殿下吧？”周维清目瞪口呆的说道。

“你认识本宫？”一个带着几分高傲的清冷声音从那宫廷女侍卫身后响起，不过，现在听起来，她的语气中却给人一种气急败坏的感觉。

周维清眼前一亮，在那宫廷女侍卫身边已经多了一人，一头湿漉漉的粉红色长发搭在肩膀上，一身金粉色的劲装勾勒出少女动人的曲线，精致的面庞上有着一双深蓝色的眼眸。因为愤怒和情绪波动，此时，她那刚刚发育的酥xiōng不断起伏着。

四目相对，周维清和那少女几乎是异口同声的惊呼出声：

前一句是周维清说的，此时他的脸色已经涨得通红，囧到了极点，心中暗想，这下可麻烦大了。尴尬的道：“帝芙雅公主，你好，没想到在这里见到你。”为了渡过眼前难关，他尽量努力的让自己看上去诚恳一些。

可惜，这位帝芙雅公主可没那么好对付，在短暂的惊讶之后，她那漂亮的脸蛋儿顿时有些扭曲，双拳紧握，“竟然是你这个废物，你居然胆敢跟踪本宫到此偷窥。尼雅，给我杀了他。”

宫廷女侍卫尼雅毫不犹豫的就要执行公主的命令，虽然她有些相信眼前这是个误会，毕竟，眼前这普通少年如果跟踪公主，是不可能不被她发觉的。可他偷看了公主的身体，确实是死有余辜。

“等一下。”周维清见过帝芙雅次数不多，也没怎么真正说过话，只是听说这位公主殿下性格高傲而已，却没想到她竟然要向自己下杀手，再不说话，自己恐怕真的要完蛋了。

尼雅抬起的长剑一缓，周维清已经飞快的说道：“别动手，我是她未婚夫。”

尼雅一呆，不禁回头向帝芙雅公主看去。看到的，是帝芙雅的一脸铁青色。

“我才没有你这样的废物未婚夫，而且你还如此猥琐、卑劣，竟然偷看我……，尼雅，动手，杀了他，一切责任有我承担。”帝芙雅愤怒的咆哮着，就像是一头小母狮子。她真是气坏了，她愤怒是有理由的，昨天她才像自己的父皇提出要解除这门婚约，今天就被周维清在这里偷看了，在她看来，一定是周维清得到了消息，来行此下流之事，再加上心中本就对无法修炼的他十分鄙视，自是怒火中烧。

尼雅看看公主殿下，再看看周维清，迟疑道：“您是牛帅的公子，周子爵？”

周维清一脸的无奈，自嘲的道：“是啊！我就是周维清，天弓帝国著名的虎父犬子中的那个犬子。也是帝芙雅公主殿下的未婚夫。我真不是有意偷看的，这里我经常来，只是凑巧碰到了，真是个误会。”

女侍卫尼雅再次回头看向帝芙雅公主，“殿下，或许这真的是个误会。子爵大人应该而已不是故意的，何况，他还是……”

“住口。”帝芙雅柳眉倒竖，一步跨出，已经来到尼雅身边，一把将她拉开，直接面对周维清，冷冷的道：“我没这样的未婚夫，我帝芙雅的目标是成为一名意宗，步入强者之林，我的丈夫必定是万人之上，俯视苍生的英雄。像他这种卑鄙下流、好涩无耻之徒也配？”

周维清原本为了活命，脸上流露出的讨好之色伴随着帝芙雅的怒斥渐渐褪去，泥人还有三分土性，眼睛也不禁瞪了起来，上下扫视着帝芙雅，“老子看你怎么了？从帝国法律上来说，你是我未来的妻子，就算我把你就地正法了，皇帝陛下都不会处罚我？没错，我就卑鄙下流、好涩无耻了，我卑鄙无耻的对象是我未婚妻，那条帝国律法管得着？而你，还不是要嫁给我这个无耻之徒？你有什么可骄傲的？不就是生的好点、天赋好点么？老子要不是先天经脉闭塞，说不定你现在巴不得让我看你洗澡，还要送上门来自荐枕席呢。你这种眼睛长在头顶的脑残女人，你以为我愿意娶你？”说着，他转身就走，这家伙平时虽然圆滑，但脾气真要上来了，却是比谁都刚硬。

论身份，帝芙雅虽然是公主，周维清还真不怕她。尽管他本身是天弓帝国的一个笑话，但是，他父亲却是天弓帝国唯一的元帅，更是天弓帝国第一强者，帝国柱石。当今天弓帝国皇帝帝峰凌与周维清的父亲私下都是以兄弟相称的，这也是为什么他和帝芙雅会有指腹为婚这种情况出现的原因了。

周维清的话正说到了帝芙雅心中痛处，正像周维清所说的那样，她虽然万般不远嫁给眼前这毫无出其之处的帝国笑话，可是，父亲的命令也是她无法违背的，一时间，新仇旧恨骤然爆发，帝芙雅一张俏脸被气得已经呈现出清白之色。

左手抬起，一层红色的光晕悄然出现在帝芙雅左手手腕之上，赫然是两颗珠子，只是和尼雅出现在右手的体珠不同。帝芙雅左手上的两颗珠子竟然是两颗夺目的红宝石，这是她的本命珠，也是意珠。帝芙雅今年十六岁，是皇室中难得的天才，天力已经修炼到了天精力第七重，更是拥有了第二颗本命珠，身为中位意师。

意珠和体珠不同，体珠主身体增幅，意珠则是控制元素之力。体珠自身的特征是各种翡翠，而意珠则是不同的有色宝石。根据宝石的颜色和样式不同，也代表着不同的属性。像帝芙雅右手手腕的两枚红宝石意珠，代表的就是火属性。除此之外，还有水属性之蓝宝石，土属性之钻石，风属性之碧玺，光属性之玻璃翠，暗属性之黑珍珠，空间属性之猫眼，生命属性之阳绿翡翠。因此，意珠师的属性更加好认，帝芙雅左手上的两枚红宝石意珠赋予她的就是火系能力。

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

Chapter 1 Sister, I think this is a misunderstanding (3)

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

The palace female guard was obviously confused by his appearance, and the anger in her eyes softened slightly, and she said coldly: "It's not my decision whether to let you go or not. Just wait for His Highness to deal with it."

"Your Highness? Oh my God! Are you talking about Her Royal Highness Princess Difuya?" Zhou Weiqing said dumbfounded.

"Do you know me?" A cold voice with a bit of arrogance sounded from behind the palace female guard. However, now it sounded like her tone gave people a feeling of exasperation.

Zhou Weiqing's eyes lit up. There was already another person beside the female palace guard. She had long wet pink hair hanging on her shoulders. She was wearing a golden-pink outfit that outlined the girl's charming curves. There was a pair of dark blue eyes on her delicate face.Because of her anger and mood swings, her newly developed breasts were constantly rising and falling.

Looking at each other, Zhou Weiqing and the girl almost exclaimed in unison:

The previous sentence was said by Zhou Weiqing. At this time, his face had turned red and he was extremely embarrassed. He thought to himself that this time he would be in big trouble.He said awkwardly: "Hello Princess Difuya, I didn't expect to see you here." In order to overcome the current difficulties, he tried his best to look sincere.

Unfortunately, this Princess Difuya is not that easy to deal with. After a brief moment of surprise, her beautiful face suddenly became distorted, and she clenched her fists, "It's you, a loser, who dares to follow me and spy here. Niya, kill him."

Niya, the female palace guard, will carry out the princess's order without hesitation, although she somewhat believes that this is a misunderstanding. After all, if the ordinary boy in front of her follows the princess, it is impossible for her to not notice it.But he took a peek at the princess's body, and he was indeed worthy of death.

"Wait a minute." Zhou Weiqing had only met Difuya a few times, and had never really spoken to her. He only heard that the princess had an arrogant personality, but he did not expect that she would actually kill him. If he didn't speak, he might really be doomed.

Niya's raised sword slowed down, and Zhou Weiqing said quickly: "Don't do anything, I am her fiancé."

Niya was stunned and couldn't help but look back at Princess Divya.What he saw was Divya's livid face.

"I don't have a good-for-nothing fiancé like you, and you are so wretched and despicable that you actually peeked at me... Niya, do it and kill him. I will bear all the responsibilities." Divya roared angrily, like a little lioness.She was really angry, and she had reason to be angry. She had just asked her father to break off the engagement yesterday, and today Zhou Weiqing was peeking in. In her opinion, Zhou Weiqing must have gotten the news and did such an obscene thing. In addition, she already despised him for being unable to practice, so she was furious.

Niya looked at Her Royal Highness the Princess, then at Zhou Weiqing, and asked hesitantly: "Are you the handsome young master, Viscount Zhou?"

Zhou Weiqing looked helpless and said mockingly: "Yes! I am Zhou Weiqing, the son of the famous tiger father of the Tiangong Empire. I am also the fiancé of Her Royal Highness Princess Difuya. I really didn't mean to peek. I come here often, but I just happened to meet him. What a misunderstanding."

The female guard Niya looked back at Princess Difuya again, "Your Highness, maybe this is really a misunderstanding. The Viscount probably didn't mean it. Besides, he still..."

"Shut up." Difuya raised her willow eyebrows. She took a step forward and came to Niya. She pulled her away and faced Zhou Weiqing directly. She said coldly: "I don't have such a fiancé. My Difuya goal is to become a Yi Zong and enter the forest of strong men. My husband must be a hero who is above ten thousand people and looks down on the people. Is he worthy of a despicable, shameless person like him?"

Zhou Weiqing was trying to survive, so the flattering look on his face gradually faded as Difuya scolded him. The clay figure still had a certain earthy nature, and his eyes couldn't help but stare. He glanced up and down at Difuya, "What do you think is wrong with you? From the Emperor's point of view,According to the national law, you are my future wife. Even if I execute you on the spot, His Majesty the Emperor will not punish me?That’s right, I am despicable and shameless. The object of my despicableness is my fiancée. That imperial lawThe law can control it?And you are not going to marry me, a shameless person?What do you have to be proud of?If I were not born with a congenital meridians, you might want to let me watch you take a shower.You even want to send me a pillow mat.You're such a stupid woman with eyes on the top of your head, do you think I'm willing to marry you?" As he said that, he turned around and left. Although this guy is usually smooth, when his temper really gets worse, he is tougher than anyone else.

In terms of status, although Difuya is a princess, Zhou Weiqing is really not afraid of her.Although he himself is a joke to the Tiangong Empire, his father is the only marshal of the Tiangong Empire, and the most powerful person in the Tiangong Empire, the pillar of the empire.Today's Gong Empire Emperor Di Fengling and Zhou Weiqing's father are known as brothers in private. This is also the reason why he and Di Fuya are married by fingertips.

Zhou Weiqing's words touched upon the pain in Difuya's heart. Just as Zhou Weiqing said, although she had no choice but to marry this nonsense imperial joke in front of her, she could not disobey her father's order. For a time, old and new grudges suddenly broke out, and Difuya's pretty face was so angry that she looked innocent.

He raised his left hand, and a red halo quietly appeared on Divya's left wrist. There were two beads, but they were different from the body beads that appeared on Niya's right hand.The two beads on Divya's left hand turned out to be two dazzling rubies. These were her birth beads and mind beads.Difuya is sixteen years old this year. She is a rare genius among the royal family. She has cultivated her Tianli to the seventh level. She also possesses the second life bead and is a mid-level mind master.

The mind beads are different from the body beads. The body beads control the growth of the body, while the mind beads control the power of elements.The body beads themselves are characterized by various emeralds, while the mind beads are different colored gemstones.Depending on the color and style of the gemstone, it also represents different attributes.The two ruby ​​beads on Difuya's right wrist represent the fire attribute.In addition, there are sapphires with water attributes, diamonds with earth attributes, tourmalines with wind attributes, glass emeralds with light attributes, black pearls with dark attributes, cat's eyes with space attributes, and sun-green jade with life attributes.Therefore, the attributes of the Yi Bead Master are easier to identify. The two ruby ​​Yi Beads on Difuya's left hand give her fire-based abilities.

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
